paragraphs.source_en: Instead, Implied Needs are just a starting point, the raw material that successful salespeople use as part of their needs-development strategy. What mat ters in the larger sale isn't the number of Implied Needs you uncover, but what you do with them after you've uncovered them. As an example of this, in the high-end sales division of the office products company, we carried out a test whereby we were able to increase the sales of 49 peo ple by 37 percent compared with a matched control group.
